name: Glimpse Eternity
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level bard 6, cleric/oracle 7, druid 7, mesmerist 6, psychic 7, sorcerer/wizard 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (a pinch of sand from an hourglass)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You call forth ancient memories of the multiverse and channel that power into a target. Unless they succeed at a Will saving throw they experience thousands of years of memories in the blink of an eye dealing 15d6 nonlethal damage and 1d6 Intelligence drain. If your target is knocked unconscious by this damage they enter a catatonic slumber for 24 hours.
